create_odf_reader: create an ODFReader instance to read tables out of OpenDocument formatted files
read_odf_sheet_names: read sheet names from an OpenDocument spreadsheet file using ODFReader
parse_odf_sheet_data: parse an ODF spreadsheet table into a list of lists with typed cell values
extract_odf_cell_values: extract typed cell values from an ODF spreadsheet including booleans, floats, strings, dates, and times
decode_odf_string_cells: decode OpenDocument text:s tags representing run-length encoded space sequences in string cells
